description: Run a pre-payment supplier and counterparty check with JPVerify: combine Japanese corporate-number, qualified-invoice (T-number) and address evidence for a supplier, add FSA licence and EDINET checks when relevant. Covers Japanese suppliers only. Use when a task involves onboarding a vendor, approving an invoice for payment, checking a vendor master in bulk, or deciding whether a counterparty needs manual review. Paid per call.
